_schema.description: npm audit gate allowlist. Keys are the NUMERIC npm advisory id (the `source` field of an npm audit `via` entry), not the GHSA string, because that is what tests/security/test-npm-audit.sh matches on. Add a reason and an optional expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD). An expired entry fails the test so exceptions get revisited: extend the date only with a fresh reachability writeup, or delete the entry once the dependency has moved past the vulnerable range.
